# F0002 — Search items

Status: ready
Source: owner:demo, 2026-11-13

## Overview

A member finds an Item by name with Item search.

## Description

### Searching items

The member enters an Item name. Item search finds the stored Item and returns
its identity. Search reads the Items that F0001 creates.

## Out of scope

- Creating an Item (F0001).
